sloka: अयोध्यां गच्छ भरत प्रकृतीरनुरञ्जय ।शत्रुघ्नसहितो वीर सह सर्वैर्द्विजातिभि: ॥ २.१०७.१५॥
transliteration: ayodhyāṁ gaccha bharata prakṛtīranurañjaya ।śatrughnasahito vīra saha sarvairdvijātibhi: ॥ 2.107.15॥

translations.english: O valiant Bharata, go to Ayodhya accompanied by Satrughna and the twiceborn (brahmins) and keep the subjects delighted like pleased (with your rule).
